$comment: Advisories we have reviewed and accepted, with the reason and the exit plan.
A package is only allowed to sit here if the ONLY available fix is a major
version bump that needs planning on its own. Anything with a non-breaking fix
must be fixed, not listed. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI on every high or
critical advisory whose package is NOT listed below, so a newly introduced
vulnerable dependency still breaks the build.
Review this file whenever the Next.js upgrade lands.

next.reason: Every listed advisory is fixed only in next@16. This app is on Next 14 App Router and calls cookies() synchronously in app/layout.tsx, which Next 15+ forbids — the upgrade is a planned migration, not a dependency bump. The advisories that carry real weight here (Image Optimizer DoS, rewrite SSRF, cache poisoning) are self-hosting and rewrite/i18n issues; this app deploys on Vercel, defines no rewrites, and uses the App Router without i18n routing.

postcss.reason: Not a direct dependency — it is bundled under node_modules/next and only runs at build time on our own stylesheets, never on attacker-supplied CSS. Resolves when next is upgraded.

glob.reason: devDependency only, reached through eslint-config-next. The advisory is command injection through the glob CLI's -c/--cmd flag; we never invoke the glob CLI, and this package is not shipped to production.

@next/eslint-plugin-next.reason: devDependency only. Flagged solely because it depends on the glob version above.

eslint-config-next.reason: devDependency only. Flagged solely because it depends on @next/eslint-plugin-next above.
